view: Oblique close view Palace of Nestor Pylos excavated megaron circular plaster hearth and four column bases around it, low rubble walls and worn patterned floor, no standing columns or modern protective roof, coherent circular perspective.

eras.title: The hearth in the palace
eras.caption: At Pylos, excavation uncovered a Mycenaean palace with a central hall arranged around a large hearth. Clay tablets found in the ruins recorded supplies and administration, preserving the work of the palace before its destruction.
